title: Tensor comparison tail for scalar-extended inverse-image modules
statement: Given the inverse-image module functor, its underlying-sheaf comparison, a scalar-extension functor T identified objectwise with change of rings, and the normalized insertion maps q, there exist tensor comparison isomorphisms for T, natural simultaneously in both module variables, satisfying the generalized pure-tensor normalization.

proof.text: Construct the comparison on sectionwise pure tensors by inserting 1 in each scalar factor. The balancing relations and sheafification universal property produce the map; the reverse map contracts the two scalar factors. Tensor induction proves the inverse identities, and the same pure-tensor calculation proves simultaneous naturality and the displayed generalized-element equation.
